items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bud Powell and I used to argue about this all the time... Bud came to hear me. A lot of people would come to hear each other because you were curious.

ctx.x: This new music that was now starting to gain some popularity, bebop or modern jazz, was it featured at all these different after hour joints or was it certain joints that catered to it?

No, basically it was played at Minton’s and wherever specific musicians would play, where Dizzy would play, where some of the others… where Kenny Clark and some of the other musicians who were very much into the exploration of the music. So they would come together at Monroe’s, they would come together at odd places, at the Savoy. They would come together at the Savoy. If you have say Cootie Williams band and Bud Powell playing piano, and you’d have some guys that couldn’t wait to sit in with… they’d say, well…
These clubs, were they just sit down audiences or was dancing also -­
